preamble: Rhotacism of the voiced postalveolar fricative [ʒ] to an alveolar tap. In some South Slavic varieties, Slovene and most Croatian dialects, Proto-Slavic *ž became r between vowels, as in moreš 'you can' from earlier možešь and the Slovene relative pronoun kdor from *kъto-že.

examples.note: Intervocalic ž > r; also in most Croatian dialects.
